items.source: An implementation of the ObjectNamingStrategy interface that reads the ObjectName from the source-level metadata.
items.translation: 一个实现 `ObjectNamingStrategy` 接口的类，该接口从源代码级别的元数据中读取 `ObjectName`。

items.source: Uses of ObjectNamingStrategy in org.springframework.jmx.export
items.translation: `ObjectNamingStrategy` 接口在 `org.springframework.jmx.export` 包中的用法

items.source: Uses of ObjectNamingStrategy in org.springframework.jmx.export.naming
items.translation: `ObjectNamingStrategy` 接口在 `org.springframework.jmx.export.naming` 包中的用法：ObjectNamingStrategy org.springframework.jmx.export.naming

items.source: ObjectNamingStrategy implementation that builds ObjectName instances from the key used in the "beans" map passed to MBeanExporter.
items.translation: 实现`ObjectNamingStrategy`，用于从传递给`MBeanExporter`的"beans"map 中使用的键构建`ObjectName`实例。

items.source: Set the implementation of the ObjectNamingStrategy interface to use for this exporter.
items.translation: 为此导出器设置用于的ObjectNamingStrategy接口的实现。

items.source: An implementation of the ObjectNamingStrategy interface that creates a name based on the identity of a given instance.
items.translation: 一个实现了ObjectNamingStrategy接口的实现，该接口会根据给定实例的身份创建名称。

items.source:
This package provides declarative creation and registration of
Spring-managed beans as JMX MBeans.
items.translation: 该包提供对 Spring 管理的 Bean 作为 JMX MBean 进行声明式创建和注册。

items.source: Provides a strategy for ObjectName creation.
items.translation: 提供用于创建 ObjectName 的策略。
